🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICAN CRUDE CRASHES TO $73.05 — UNDER HACIENDA'S 2026 FLOOR</u>

The Mezcla Mexicana closed Tuesday at $73.05 per barrel, down 6% from Monday and the lowest since March 4, putting it 5.4% below the $77.3 baseline baked into the Pre-Criterios Generales de Política Económica 2027. SHCP estimates each $1 swing equals about 9.6 billion pesos in petroleum income; the YTD average sits at $81.94 (still 6% above plan), but the slide tracks the US-Iran Hormuz memorandum that crushed the geopolitical risk premium overnight. "The MOU significantly reduced the probability of immediate disruption," Rystad's Jorge León told El Financiero. Pemex's $80B debt now meets a slimmer fiscal cushion right as Sheinbaum doubles down on autosuficiencia energética — Manzanillo 357MW just came online Friday.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>MULTI-STATE STRIKE: 2.541 BILLION PESO BLOW TO NARCO + HUACHICOL</u>

Coordinated 24-hour operation across Puebla, Edomex, Durango, Sinaloa, Baja California, Michoacán and Zacatecas: 360 kilos of methamphetamine plus precursors and industrial reactors seized in Tlapacoya, dismantling a major synthetic lab; an underground tunnel running to a clandestine Pemex pipeline tap discovered in Ecatepec; 26 homemade IEDs and gunpowder lab in Durango; 11 strategic drug points wiped in Sinaloa. Army, Guardia Nacional, FGR, SSPC and Pemex personnel ran the strike together. Total damage to criminal organizations: 2.541 billion pesos. The right-wing narrative says cartels "run Mexico." The receipts say otherwise.

🇲🇽📱 <u>SHEINBAUM OPENS NATIONAL DEBATE: REGULATE KIDS' SCREEN TIME + AI</u>

Children in Manzanillo told the president directly they spend 2-4 hours a day on TikTok; her government's parent survey found majority backing for phone bans in basic education. "Many studies show how anxiety in young people is closely tied to screen attachment," Sheinbaum said, flagging impacts on sleep that she called "vital" for memory consolidation and development — and warning about validation-by-likes during identity formation. She paired the screen-time push with a parallel call for Mexican AI regulation, refusing to wait while Europe and Australia move ahead and the US privatizes the conversation entirely. Sovereignty isn't only borders. It's also the algorithm.

🇲🇽⚡ <u>CFE TARGETS 99.99% ELECTRIC COVERAGE BY 2028 — 45,000 PROJECTS, 21.4B PESOS</u>

Energy Secretary Luz Elena González and CFE director Emilia Calleja laid out the buildout from the morning briefing: current coverage at 99.85% (~50 million users), 8,247 localities still off-grid, 21.377 billion pesos invested across over 45,000 works — versus only 26,635 total electrification projects completed in the entire 2006-2018 neoliberal era. "Development should not depend on postal codes, distance, or geographic conditions," Calleja said. 1,520 projects target indigenous communities — Seri territories in Sonora, Sierra Tarahumara, San Quintín, Michoacán, Navolato — the places the privatization model wrote off.

⚖️🇲🇽 <u>CNTE REACHES AZTECA AREA, ACCEPTS GOBERNACIÓN TABLE — SHEINBAUM: "¿PARA QUÉ?"</u>

Sections 34 and 58 of Zacatecas reached Estadio Ciudad de México in "operativo hormiga" hours before the Korea-Mexico Mundial match, while CNTE national leadership accepted SEGOB's 1:30pm dialogue invitation at Palacio de Cobián with ISSSTE and SEP present. Sheinbaum from the mañanera: "qué caso tiene que marchen hoy al estadio, para qué" — questioning both the timing and the union's representativeness right after she announced direct teacher consultations in August that bypass union leadership. The 12-day Zócalo encampment was already lifted; today's move tested whether Mundial visibility creates new leverage. Sheinbaum tested back.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>TRUMP CALLS SHEINBAUM "VERY SCARED WOMAN" FROM G7 — DIPLOMACY-BY-INSULT PLAYBOOK</u>

At the Evian G7 summit closing today, Trump told reporters "the cartels run Mexico, it's sad" and described Sheinbaum as "a good woman, but a very scared woman" — the same script he ran on Castillo, Petro, and Lula. Meanwhile Sheinbaum has driven the daily homicide rate down 46% since September 2024 (86.9 → 47.3), signed the bilateral GBI fentanyl framework that helped cut US overdoses 22.1%, and held off the US military twice this year. The "asustada" line is projection: the empire is the one losing leverage at the table.

🇲🇽🔥🐉 Sheinbaum bloquea el "Made in USA only": México defiende reglas T-MEC integradas

A días de la segunda ronda de revisión del T-MEC en Washington, Claudia Sheinbaum trazó la línea: México rechaza convertir el tratado en un régimen de contenido exclusivamente estadounidense. "Nuestro objetivo es mantener el acuerdo, y creemos que no habrá problema con eso", declaró el 16 de junio. La presión gringa busca empujar a México hacia reglas de origen que beneficien solo a Washington — la 4T responde con producción norteamericana integrada, no con vasallaje.

La prioridad mexicana es bajar los aranceles Sección 232 sobre acero, aluminio y vehículos — los que más golpean al empleo industrial nacional. Sheinbaum: "Ahí enfocamos nuestros esfuerzos, en asegurar al menos una reducción significativa mientras el acuerdo siga vigente". Marcelo Ebrard lidera las negociaciones; la tercera ronda está agendada para el 20 de julio en Ciudad de México.

El subtexto geopolítico es transparente: Washington quiere que México expulse insumos chinos de sus cadenas productivas. Pero México apuesta por integración regional norteamericana sin sacrificar el comercio con Asia. Es la diferencia entre socio y satélite — y la 4T la marca con datos, no con genuflexiones.

🐉🌐🇲🇽 América Latina pivota: exportaciones a China +25% en Q1 2026, mientras EU se rezaga

El BID publicó hoy datos que confirman el reordenamiento del comercio hemisférico. Las exportaciones latinoamericanas a China crecieron 25% en el primer trimestre de 2026, frente a apenas 14% hacia Estados Unidos. Las importaciones desde China subieron 29% en la región; las de EU apenas 4%. Beijing es ya el comprador más dinámico del Sur Global.

Mientras Washington amenaza con aranceles, el resto del continente diversifica. Las exportaciones totales de América Latina crecieron 16% interanual, el doble que en 2025. Oro +64%, cobre, soja y mineral de hierro al alza. China lidera en Sudamérica; EU sigue dominando en México y Centroamérica gracias a la integración del T-MEC.

El informe del BID es directo: "la inestabilidad de las políticas comerciales globales y la proliferación de conflictos geopolíticos" generan incertidumbre. Traducción: el unilateralismo de Trump empuja a la región hacia el mundo multipolar. México mantiene un pie en cada puerta — y eso, no la sumisión, es soberanía económica.
